skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply fundamental concepts of real estate management, including financial management, marketing, and contract drafting.
Analyze financial statements and reports of real estate businesses, and assess financial performance.
Understand and draft real estate contracts, and analyze contract terms.
Apply marketing strategies and tools in real estate sales and distribution.
Develop negotiation skills for real estate transactions.
Work effectively in teams to solve real estate business problems.
Analyze and evaluate real estate business activities and risks.
Prepare and deliver effective presentations on real estate topics.
